calls.title: Jennifer Pham-Le and Katie Jones
calls.summary: The meeting focused on completing the resubmission of a hiring request after necessary assessment updates, which led to HR approval and contract issuance. Jennifer and Katie discussed the Labor Portage and Consultant models, weighing their compliance and security implications. The Labor Portage model is advised for legality, featuring a 36-month maximum contract with a cooling-off period, while the Consultant model offers more flexibility but less client control. Contract termination procedures were reviewed, highlighting severance responsibilities if the company initiates termination after six months. Additionally, employee onboarding support was emphasized, with Katie providing resources to streamline the hiring process and remain available for assistance.
calls.keywords: Labor Portage, Consultancy model, French employment law, hiring assessment, contract termination, Rippling EOR

calls.title: Jennifer Pham-Le and Katie Jones
calls.summary: The discussion focused on addressing confusion related to the visibility of variable commissions in employee contracts, specifically how they appear in offer letters. Jennifer and Katie highlighted that while the commission is indicated in employee profiles, it is not clearly documented in offer letters, leading to employee inquiries. They discussed the differences between French EOR contracts—which often include variable pay in separate addendums—and UK contracts where it is bundled. Additionally, the meeting provided insights on the Labor Portage model, emphasizing its 36-month limitation, severance pay, and conditions for extending contracts. Furthermore, the implications of the Consultant model were reviewed, which offers more flexibility but incurs higher termination costs. Legal considerations regarding contract amendments were addressed, and steps for improving contract clarity were outlined.
calls.keywords: labor portage, consultant model, variable commission, Rippling contract, severance, employment termination

calls.title: Jennifer Pham-Le and Katie Jones
calls.summary: During the meeting, major topics included the finalization of employee agreements, specifically for new hire Remy, with equity and commission plans being incorporated into his profile. It was confirmed that Remy’s earliest start date is August 3rd. The discussion also covered the labor portage model, under which consultants like Remy must find new clients within one month post-termination, while being paid from accumulated financial reserves. Insights about PTO policies revealed Spain offers flexible PTO arrangements with potential negative leave, while France's policy is capped with no negative balances permitted. Additionally, payroll processes and notifications for employees, especially for those starting on August 10th, were reviewed, emphasizing a seamless onboarding experience and thorough use of the Rippling HR system.
